```{r}
# ============================================================
# Similarity Network Fusion analysis
# Integrated fungal, viral and host profile
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(SNFtool)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(ggalluvial)
})

set.seed(123)

# ============================================================
# Paths
# ============================================================

project_root <- "C:/Users/valfr/OneDrive/Documents/Masters/Research Project"
data_dir     <- file.path(project_root, "Data")
results_dir  <- file.path(project_root, "Results")
figures_dir  <- file.path(project_root, "Figures")

snf_results_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "SNF")
snf_figures_dir <- file.path(figures_dir, "SNF")

dir.create(snf_results_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(snf_figures_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

metadata_file_tsv <- file.path(data_dir, "metadata_clean.tsv")

fungal_file <- file.path(
  data_dir,
  "refseq_fungal_genus_2pct.totalcount_gt_1.prevalence_0p02.tsv"
)

viral_file <- file.path(
  data_dir,
  "refseq_viral_genus_2pct.totalcount_gt_1.prevalence_0p02.tsv"
)

# ============================================================
# Read metadata
# ============================================================

meta <- read.delim(
  metadata_file_tsv,
  sep = "\t",
  check.names = FALSE
)

colnames(meta)[1] <- "sample_label"

# ============================================================
# Colour maps
# ============================================================

outcome_cols <- c(
  "TERM" = "#1f77b4",
  "sPTB" = "#ff7f0e"
)

delivery_cols <- c(
  "TERM" = "#1f77b4",
  "sPTB 34–37" = "#9467bd",
  "sPTB <34" = "#ff7f0e"
)

cluster_cols <- c(
  "Cluster 1" = "#0072B2",
  "Cluster 2" = "#E69F00",
  "Cluster 3" = "#009E73",
  "Cluster 4" = "#CC79A7"
)

get_fungal_color_map <- function() {
  c(
    "Aspergillus"   = "#E69F00",
    "Saccharomyces" = "#56B4E9",
    "Fusarium"      = "#44AA99",
    "Trichoderma"   = "#CC6677",
    "Cryptococcus"  = "#117733",
    "Puccinia"      = "#AA4499"
  )
}

get_viral_color_map <- function() {
  c(
    "Shenzhenivirus" = "#CC79A7",
    "Fohxhuevirus"  = "#882255"
  )
}

# ============================================================
# Helper functions
# ============================================================

read_matrix <- function(file_path) {
  mat <- read.delim(
    file_path,
    row.names = 1,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  mat <- as.data.frame(mat)
  mat[] <- lapply(mat, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))

  return(mat)
}

align_to_metadata <- function(mat, meta) {
  matrix_ids_clean <- sub("_1$", "", rownames(mat))

  unmatched <- setdiff(matrix_ids_clean, meta$reads_ID)

  if (length(unmatched) > 0) {
    stop("Unmatched samples found: ", paste(unmatched, collapse = ", "))
  }

  meta_matched <- meta[
    match(matrix_ids_clean, meta$reads_ID),
  ]

  if (!all(meta_matched$reads_ID == matrix_ids_clean)) {
    stop("Metadata order mismatch")
  }

  rownames(mat) <- matrix_ids_clean
  rownames(meta_matched) <- meta_matched$reads_ID

  return(list(mat = mat, meta = meta_matched))
}

select_existing_features <- function(mat, features, layer_name) {
  present <- intersect(features, colnames(mat))
  missing <- setdiff(features, colnames(mat))

  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    message("Missing in ", layer_name, ": ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  }

  if (length(present) == 0) {
    stop("No requested features found in ", layer_name)
  }

  mat[, present, drop = FALSE]
}

clr_transform <- function(mat) {
  mat <- as.matrix(mat)

  min_positive <- min(mat[mat > 0], na.rm = TRUE)

  if (!is.finite(min_positive)) {
    stop("No positive values available for CLR transformation.")
  }

  pseudocount <- min_positive / 2
  mat_pc <- mat + pseudocount

  clr <- t(apply(mat_pc, 1, function(x) {
    log(x) - mean(log(x))
  }))

  clr <- as.data.frame(clr)
  rownames(clr) <- rownames(mat)

  return(clr)
}

zscore_matrix <- function(mat) {
  mat <- as.data.frame(mat)

  mat <- mat[, apply(mat, 2, function(x) {
    sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
  }), drop = FALSE]

  scaled <- scale(mat)
  scaled[is.na(scaled)] <- 0

  scaled <- as.data.frame(scaled)
  rownames(scaled) <- rownames(mat)

  return(scaled)
}

format_feature_names <- function(x) {
  recode(
    x,
    "IL6" = "IL-6",
    "IL37_pg_mL" = "IL-37",
    "Lactate" = "Lactate",
    "Succinate" = "Succinate",
    "Putrescine" = "Putrescine"
  )
}

make_affinity_matrix <- function(layer, K = 10, sigma = 0.5) {
  layer <- as.matrix(layer)
  distance_matrix <- dist2(layer, layer)

  affinityMatrix(
    distance_matrix,
    K = K,
    sigma = sigma
  )
}

choose_cluster_number <- function(fused_network, k_values = 2:4) {
  distance_object <- as.dist(1 - fused_network)

  cluster_summary <- lapply(k_values, function(k) {
    clusters <- spectralClustering(fused_network, K = k)

    sil <- cluster::silhouette(
      clusters,
      distance_object
    )

    data.frame(
      k = k,
      mean_silhouette = mean(sil[, "sil_width"])
    )
  }) %>%
    bind_rows()

  best_k <- cluster_summary$k[
    which.max(cluster_summary$mean_silhouette)
  ]

  return(list(
    cluster_summary = cluster_summary,
    best_k = best_k
  ))
}

# ============================================================
# Read and align fungal and viral data
# ============================================================

fungi <- read_matrix(fungal_file)
fungi_aligned <- align_to_metadata(fungi, meta)

fungi <- fungi_aligned$mat
meta_aligned <- fungi_aligned$meta

viruses <- read_matrix(viral_file)
viruses_aligned <- align_to_metadata(viruses, meta)

viruses <- viruses_aligned$mat

# ============================================================
# Define selected features
# ============================================================

fungal_candidates <- c(
  "Aspergillus",
  "Fusarium",
  "Cryptococcus",
  "Puccinia",
  "Saccharomyces",
  "Trichoderma"
)

viral_candidates <- c(
  "Shenzhenivirus",
  "Fohxhuevirus"
)

host_features <- c(
  "IL6",
  "IL37_pg_mL",
  "Lactate",
  "Succinate",
  "Putrescine"
)

# ============================================================
# Check that metadata-derived host features exist
# ============================================================

missing_host_features <- setdiff(
  host_features,
  colnames(meta_aligned)
)

if (length(missing_host_features) > 0) {
  stop(
    "These required host features are missing from metadata_clean.tsv: ",
    paste(missing_host_features, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# ============================================================
# Prepare SNF layers
# ============================================================

fungal_layer <- fungi %>%
  select_existing_features(fungal_candidates, "RefSeq fungi") %>%
  clr_transform() %>%
  zscore_matrix()

viral_layer <- viruses %>%
  select_existing_features(viral_candidates, "RefSeq viruses") %>%
  clr_transform() %>%
  zscore_matrix()

host_layer <- meta_aligned[, host_features, drop = FALSE]
host_layer[] <- lapply(
  host_layer,
  function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x))
)
rownames(host_layer) <- meta_aligned$reads_ID
host_layer <- zscore_matrix(host_layer)

# ============================================================
# Match samples across all layers
# ============================================================

common_samples <- Reduce(
  intersect,
  list(
    rownames(fungal_layer),
    rownames(viral_layer),
    rownames(host_layer)
  )
)

metadata_model <- meta_aligned[
  common_samples,
  c("reads_ID", "sample_label", "outcome", "sPTB34"),
  drop = FALSE
]

# ============================================================
# Remove samples with missing outcome or model features
# ============================================================

complete_sample_check <- bind_cols(
  metadata_model,
  fungal_layer[common_samples, , drop = FALSE],
  viral_layer[common_samples, , drop = FALSE],
  host_layer[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]
)

complete_samples <- complete_sample_check$reads_ID[
  complete.cases(complete_sample_check)
]

metadata_model <- metadata_model[complete_samples, , drop = FALSE]

fungal_layer <- fungal_layer[complete_samples, , drop = FALSE]
viral_layer <- viral_layer[complete_samples, , drop = FALSE]
host_layer <- host_layer[complete_samples, , drop = FALSE]

# ============================================================
# Build similarity networks
# ============================================================

K <- 10
sigma <- 0.5
t <- 20

fungal_network <- make_affinity_matrix(
  fungal_layer,
  K = K,
  sigma = sigma
)

viral_network <- make_affinity_matrix(
  viral_layer,
  K = K,
  sigma = sigma
)

host_network <- make_affinity_matrix(
  host_layer,
  K = K,
  sigma = sigma
)

network_list <- list(
  fungal_network,
  viral_network,
  host_network
)

# ============================================================
# Run Similarity Network Fusion
# ============================================================

fused_network <- SNF(
  Wall = network_list,
  K = K,
  t = t
)

rownames(fused_network) <- complete_samples
colnames(fused_network) <- complete_samples

saveRDS(
  fused_network,
  file.path(snf_results_dir, "SNF_fused_network.rds")
)

# ============================================================
# Spectral clustering and cluster number selection
# ============================================================

cluster_selection <- choose_cluster_number(
  fused_network,
  k_values = 2:4
)

write.csv(
  cluster_selection$cluster_summary,
  file.path(snf_results_dir, "SNF_cluster_number_silhouette_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

best_k <- cluster_selection$best_k

snf_clusters <- spectralClustering(
  fused_network,
  K = best_k
)

cluster_df <- data.frame(
  reads_ID = complete_samples,
  sample_label = metadata_model$sample_label,
  SNF_cluster = paste0("Cluster ", snf_clusters),
  outcome = metadata_model$outcome,
  sPTB34 = metadata_model$sPTB34
)

# ============================================================
# Create three delivery groups
# ============================================================

cluster_df$delivery_group <- NA

cluster_df$delivery_group[
  cluster_df$outcome == "TERM"
] <- "TERM"

cluster_df$delivery_group[
  cluster_df$outcome == "sPTB" &
    cluster_df$sPTB34 == "yes"
] <- "sPTB <34"

cluster_df$delivery_group[
  cluster_df$outcome == "sPTB" &
    cluster_df$sPTB34 == "no"
] <- "sPTB 34–37"

cluster_df$delivery_group <- factor(
  cluster_df$delivery_group,
  levels = c(
    "TERM",
    "sPTB 34–37",
    "sPTB <34"
  )
)

write.csv(
  cluster_df,
  file.path(snf_results_dir, "SNF_sample_clusters.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ============================================================
# Test association between SNF clusters and outcomes
# ============================================================

cluster_outcome_table <- table(
  cluster_df$SNF_cluster,
  cluster_df$outcome
)

cluster_sPTB34_table <- table(
  cluster_df$SNF_cluster,
  cluster_df$sPTB34
)

cluster_delivery_table <- table(
  cluster_df$SNF_cluster,
  cluster_df$delivery_group
)

cluster_outcome_test <- fisher.test(cluster_outcome_table)
cluster_sPTB34_test <- fisher.test(cluster_sPTB34_table)

cluster_delivery_test <- chisq.test(
  cluster_delivery_table,
  simulate.p.value = TRUE,
  B = 10000
)

cluster_tests <- data.frame(
  comparison = c(
    "SNF cluster vs outcome",
    "SNF cluster vs sPTB34",
    "SNF cluster vs delivery group"
  ),
  p_value = c(
    cluster_outcome_test$p.value,
    cluster_sPTB34_test$p.value,
    cluster_delivery_test$p.value
  )
)

write.csv(
  cluster_tests,
  file.path(snf_results_dir, "SNF_cluster_outcome_tests.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  as.data.frame(cluster_outcome_table),
  file.path(snf_results_dir, "SNF_cluster_by_outcome_table.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  as.data.frame(cluster_sPTB34_table),
  file.path(snf_results_dir, "SNF_cluster_by_sPTB34_table.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  as.data.frame(cluster_delivery_table),
  file.path(snf_results_dir, "SNF_cluster_by_delivery_group_table.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ============================================================
# Test feature differences across SNF clusters
# ============================================================

feature_matrix <- bind_cols(
  fungal_layer,
  viral_layer,
  host_layer
)

feature_tests <- lapply(colnames(feature_matrix), function(feature) {
  test_df <- data.frame(
    value = feature_matrix[[feature]],
    SNF_cluster = cluster_df$SNF_cluster
  )

  kw <- kruskal.test(value ~ SNF_cluster, data = test_df)

  data.frame(
    feature = feature,
    feature_label = format_feature_names(feature),
    p_value = kw$p.value
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(
    q_value = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  arrange(q_value)

write.csv(
  feature_tests,
  file.path(snf_results_dir, "SNF_cluster_feature_tests.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ============================================================
# Prepare feature heatmap matrix
# ============================================================

feature_matrix_plot <- feature_matrix
colnames(feature_matrix_plot) <- format_feature_names(colnames(feature_matrix_plot))

feature_matrix_plot <- as.matrix(feature_matrix_plot)

annotation_col <- cluster_df %>%
  select(reads_ID, SNF_cluster, outcome, sPTB34, delivery_group) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(annotation_col) <- annotation_col$reads_ID
annotation_col$reads_ID <- NULL

annotation_col <- annotation_col[colnames(t(feature_matrix_plot)), , drop = FALSE]

annotation_colors <- list(
  SNF_cluster = cluster_cols,
  outcome = outcome_cols,
  sPTB34 = c(
    "yes" = "#ff7f0e",
    "no" = "#1f77b4"
  ),
  delivery_group = delivery_cols
)

# ============================================================
# Fused similarity matrix heatmap
# ============================================================

annotation_network <- cluster_df %>%
  select(reads_ID, delivery_group, SNF_cluster) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(annotation_network) <- annotation_network$reads_ID
annotation_network$reads_ID <- NULL

annotation_network <- annotation_network[
  rownames(fused_network),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

# Rename annotation labels
colnames(annotation_network) <- c(
  "Outcome",
  "SNF cluster"
)

# Annotation colours
annotation_colors_network <- list(
  "Outcome" = delivery_cols,
  "SNF cluster" = cluster_cols
)

# Heatmap
pheatmap(
  fused_network,
  annotation_row = annotation_network,
  annotation_col = annotation_network,
  annotation_colors = annotation_colors_network,

  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,

  show_rownames = FALSE,
  show_colnames = FALSE,

  border_color = NA,

  color = viridis::viridis(100),

  breaks = seq(
    min(fused_network),
    max(fused_network),
    length.out = 101
  ),

  main = "SNF fused similarity network",

  filename = file.path(
    snf_figures_dir,
    "SNF_fused_similarity_heatmap.png"
  ),

  width = 8,
  height = 7
)
# ============================================================
# Feature heatmap ordered by SNF cluster
# ============================================================

feature_matrix_plot <- feature_matrix
colnames(feature_matrix_plot) <- format_feature_names(colnames(feature_matrix_plot))

feature_matrix_plot <- as.matrix(feature_matrix_plot)

ordered_samples <- cluster_df %>%
  arrange(SNF_cluster, delivery_group) %>%
  pull(reads_ID)

feature_heatmap <- t(feature_matrix_plot[ordered_samples, , drop = FALSE])

annotation_col_heatmap <- cluster_df %>%
  select(reads_ID, SNF_cluster, delivery_group) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(annotation_col_heatmap) <- annotation_col_heatmap$reads_ID
annotation_col_heatmap$reads_ID <- NULL

annotation_col_heatmap <- annotation_col_heatmap[
  ordered_samples,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

# Rename annotation labels shown on the heatmap
colnames(annotation_col_heatmap) <- c(
  "SNF cluster",
  "Outcome"
)

annotation_colors_heatmap <- list(
  "SNF cluster" = cluster_cols,
  "Outcome" = delivery_cols
)

pheatmap(
  feature_heatmap,
  annotation_col = annotation_col_heatmap,
  annotation_colors = annotation_colors_heatmap,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 10,
  fontsize_col = 6,
  border_color = NA,
  color = colorRampPalette(
    c("#440154", "#21908C", "#FDE725")
  )(100),
  main = "Integrated fungal, viral and host features",
  filename = file.path(
    snf_figures_dir,
    "SNF_feature_heatmap_ordered_by_cluster.png"
  ),
  width = 9,
  height = 6
)

# ============================================================
# SNF PCoA coordinates
# ============================================================

snf_distance <- as.dist(1 - fused_network)

snf_coords <- cmdscale(
  snf_distance,
  k = 2,
  eig = TRUE
)

coord_df <- as.data.frame(snf_coords$points)
colnames(coord_df) <- c("SNF1", "SNF2")
coord_df$reads_ID <- rownames(coord_df)

variance_explained <- round(
  100 * snf_coords$eig[1:2] / sum(snf_coords$eig[snf_coords$eig > 0]),
  1
)

plot_df <- coord_df %>%
  left_join(cluster_df, by = "reads_ID")

# ============================================================
# PCoA coloured by SNF cluster
# ============================================================

p_cluster <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = SNF1, y = SNF2, colour = SNF_cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cluster_cols) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "SNF integrated sample structure",
    x = paste0("SNF coordinate 1 (", variance_explained[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("SNF coordinate 2 (", variance_explained[2], "%)"),
    colour = "SNF cluster"
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(snf_figures_dir, "SNF_PCoA_by_cluster.png"),
  p_cluster,
  width = 7,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)

print(p_cluster)

# ============================================================
# PCoA coloured by delivery group
# ============================================================

p_delivery <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = SNF1, y = SNF2, colour = delivery_group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = delivery_cols) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "SNF integrated sample structure by delivery group",
    x = paste0("SNF coordinate 1 (", variance_explained[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("SNF coordinate 2 (", variance_explained[2], "%)"),
    colour = "Delivery group"
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(snf_figures_dir, "SNF_PCoA_by_delivery_group.png"),
  p_delivery,
  width = 7,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)

print(p_delivery)

# ============================================================
# Cluster composition bar plot
# ============================================================

cluster_composition <- cluster_df %>%
  count(SNF_cluster, delivery_group) %>%
  group_by(SNF_cluster) %>%
  mutate(
    proportion = n / sum(n)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

write.csv(
  cluster_composition,
  file.path(snf_results_dir, "SNF_cluster_composition.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

p_composition <- ggplot(
  cluster_composition,
  aes(x = SNF_cluster, y = proportion, fill = delivery_group)
) +
  geom_col(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = delivery_cols) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Delivery group composition of SNF clusters",
    x = "SNF cluster",
    y = "Proportion of samples",
    fill = "Delivery group"
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(snf_figures_dir, "SNF_cluster_delivery_group_composition.png"),
  p_composition,
  width = 6,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)

print(p_composition)

# ============================================================
# Alluvial plot: delivery group and SNF cluster
# ============================================================

alluvial_df <- cluster_df %>%
  count(delivery_group, SNF_cluster)

p_alluvial <- ggplot(
  alluvial_df,
  aes(
    axis1 = delivery_group,
    axis2 = SNF_cluster,
    y = n
  )
) +
  geom_alluvium(
    aes(fill = delivery_group),
    width = 0.18,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_stratum(
    width = 0.18,
    fill = "grey90",
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_text(
    stat = "stratum",
    aes(label = after_stat(stratum)),
    size = 2.6,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = c("Delivery group", "SNF cluster"),
    expand = c(0.2, 0.2)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = delivery_cols) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Relationship between delivery group and SNF clusters",
    y = "Number of samples",
    fill = "Delivery group"
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(
    snf_figures_dir,
    "SNF_delivery_group_cluster_alluvial.png"
  ),
  p_alluvial,
  width = 8.5,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 300
)

print(p_alluvial)

# ============================================================
# Save full SNF object
# ============================================================

snf_object <- list(
  fungal_layer = fungal_layer,
  viral_layer = viral_layer,
  host_layer = host_layer,
  fungal_network = fungal_network,
  viral_network = viral_network,
  host_network = host_network,
  fused_network = fused_network,
  cluster_selection = cluster_selection,
  clusters = cluster_df,
  cluster_tests = cluster_tests,
  feature_tests = feature_tests,
  coordinates = plot_df
)

saveRDS(
  snf_object,
  file.path(snf_results_dir, "SNF_complete_object.rds")
)

# ============================================================
# Save reproducibility information
# ============================================================

sink(file.path(snf_results_dir, "session_info.txt"))
sessionInfo()
sink()
```
